notes.title: Gameplay Trailer #2: Rotor Clash
notes.content:
[h1]Gunship pilots![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415715/a61c40777230ecb29b542b0e5364759df8f18d9c.gif"][/img][/p][p]The Viper Commando proudly presents the second gameplay trailer of [b]COBRA STRIKE[/b].[/p][p]Discover your favorite and freshly arrived gunships, choppers, aircraft and watch them in close-range combat and action-packed encounters.[/p][p][/p][h2]Watch the new gameplay trailer here:[/h2][previewyoutube="YXWuSImcECs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Some new rotors and wings were directly suggested here by the Steam Community:[/p][p]Thanks to BlackjackGT, TigerPAH2, Daredevil_314 and Orc01![/p][p]Much appreciated![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415715/d99a4ab5ef2e651211d41ae6327a2b04691053df.gif"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for all your input![/p][p]You're are shaping [b]COBRA STRIKE[/b] already in the right direction and to its ideal form. Let's make it the best together! Blast from the past - right into an aspiring retro gaming future![/p][p][/p][p]Meanwhile your squad leader continues development of a playable version, 
so that you can shape [b]COBRA STRIKE[/b] even more regarding, piloting, aiming, targeting and combating.[/p][p]Enlist [url="https://cobrastrikegame.com/"]here[/url] to do so or leave a comment in the Discussions [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3411810/discussions/"]here[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3411810/discussions/0/595139065567797017/"]Playable Chopper[/url] list, [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3411810/discussions/0/595139065567791440/"]F.A.Q.[/url] and [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3411810/discussions/0/595139065567792381/"]Feature Requests[/url] were updated too.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Also participate in the new community survey in the [/b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3411810/discussions/0/597412591711705491/"]Steam Discussions[/url][b] regarding new feature requests and game design decisions - your feedback matters![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for further intel and updates![/p][p][/p][p]Dismissed![/p][p]-somasolo[/p]
